name: Hour of the Rat
source:
Minato Yoshizawa is just another office worker or so she believes. Yet part of her hopes for the return of Tomika Aoyagi, her once-close friend.

Meanwhile, Yuki Ichinose struggles with personal demons, her mother’s illness, and strange visitors.

When their worlds collide, nothing will remain the same.

[From [url=https://orcasecrets.itch.io/hotr-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
